record.body:
## Interfaces

- execute-phase / plan-phase / verify-work skills document retry selection, amendments, fix tasks, budget, and next: plan using optional work-item `attempts` from the contract.
- Dashboard TaskRow reads `attempts` and effective budget (default 2 or phase run-fact override) and renders `attempt n/budget` without depending on skill text.

## Assumptions

- Closing verification remains the work-item that depends_on every other phase task (fix-task re-gating).
- Runner check-runs supply output tails for assignment-amendment Correction text.
- Parallel wave file split (skills/contract/tests vs dashboard) held; both landed on the same phase branch tip.

## Invariants

- `done` work-items are not reopened; fix tasks are new subjects.
- Single-writer store preserved (subagents wrote code only).
- Budget exhaustion path is documented to surface Needs you.

## Conflicts

none
